scope: Provisional synthetic V2 evaluation; human review pending.

interpretation.claim: Guarded Kimi K3 outperformed bare Kimi K3 on this frozen synthetic V2 snapshot under identical execution budgets.
interpretation.scope: 80 cases, 20 synthetic families, three repetitions per system. Human benchmark validation remains pending.
interpretation.attribution: The guard and procedural prompt are evaluated together; no ablation isolates their contributions. Neither system executed an unsafe action; the guard blocked zero proposals. Most improvement is evidence/decision compliance.
interpretation.cost: Unknown dollar cost. Solution total tokens are about 8% higher; no lower-cost claim.
interpretation.remaining_solution_failures: Three reason-code mismatches; all final business states and evidence requirements passed.
interpretation.tuning: Solution frozen before evaluation; no modifications based on evaluation failures.
